title: TCG:Pre-Release Cards
summary: Pre-Release Cards are a special set of Huntik Trading Card Game cards that were distributed prior to the game’s official launch at Sneak Preview events organized by Upper Deck. These cards are identical to their Secrets and Seekers counterparts in artwork and statistics, but replace the ability and flavor text with a Huntik.com password for players to unlock exclusive online content. The cards were first distributed at an "Upper Deck Day" event in Febrary 2009 which allowed players an early access experience of playing the game. They were also made available at future launch and tournament events alongside the Promotional Cards.

'''Pre-Release Cards''' are a special set of [[Huntik Trading Card Game]] cards that were distributed prior to the game’s official launch at Sneak Preview events organized by [[Upper Deck]]. These cards are identical to their [[TCG:Secrets and Seekers|Secrets and Seekers]] counterparts in artwork and statistics, but replace the ability and flavor text with a [[Huntik.com]] password for players to unlock exclusive online content. The cards were first distributed at an "Upper Deck Day" event in Febrary 2009 which allowed players an early access experience of playing the game. They were also made available at future launch and tournament events alongside the [[TCG:Promotional Cards|Promotional Cards]].
